revision: layout01-v4 is bounded revision 1 of layout01-v3 (Codex verification-01 blockers R1-01..R1-04). v3 files are unchanged; this candidate supersedes v3 locally: mouthless moustache remnant, moustache-footprint underdraw, small-open test opening, and lower-neck garment cleanup.
coordinate_convention: top-left origin; +x right, +y down; character-perspective left/right

provenance.reconstruction_method: Three local reconstructions: (1) feature underdraw — solid interiors (alpha>=252) of the eye/eyebrow/nose footprints (5922 px) inpainted by Laplacian diffusion from the surrounding master skin so features can move in a later phase (v3 recipe, unchanged); (2) R1-02 moustache-footprint underdraw — 1394 px of the moustache matte U inside the head region filled with diffused skin (boundary seeded by surrounding master art; invisible dark non-head pixels in the seed box are added to the diffusion region so ink/beard colours do not leak); (3) R1-04 lower-neck cleanup — 277 garment pixels (strict garment gold r>=150 & r-b>=140 & b<=70, blend fringe r>=120 & r-b>=90 & b<=70, and pale collar trim r>=200 & 30<=r-b<=110 & g>=185, all y>=300) replaced with strand-continuation diffusion seeded by the head layer's own kept colours plus hair_back where the head is transparent. Skin/neck silhouette otherwise follows the master inside the immutable head domain.
provenance.alpha_edge_modifications: alpha equals master alpha inside the domain-bounded region; feature-interior, moustache-footprint, and neck-clean RGB reconstructed

provenance.reconstruction_method: R1-04: 6 garment-gold pixels (b<=70 family, y>=300) replaced with strand-continuation diffusion seeded by surrounding hair_back strands and head skin.
provenance.alpha_edge_modifications: alpha equals master alpha; 6 garment px RGB reconstructed

provenance.reconstruction_method: Mouthless receiver: the mouth-content region M (2616 px, bbox x500-580 y228-269) is filled with beard texture tiled from the verified all-dark master block y270-293 x494-604; R1-02 adds the moustache-footprint underdraw — 345 px of U inside the beard region outside M filled with the same cloned texture so +-1px moustache offsets reveal clean beard instead of the old feature outline; 304 previously-uncovered domain pixels are recovered master pixels.
provenance.alpha_edge_modifications: alpha equals master alpha inside the beard region; RGB inside M and the U underdraw reconstructed (cloned texture)

provenance.reconstruction_method: R1-01/R1-02 matte decontamination over the v2 extraction: for every U pixel above a faithful reconstructed underlay (skin underdraw in head_base or the patch underdraw), (alpha, RGB) is re-solved so the pixel composites to the exact master colour over the neutral underlay and goes dark over the mouthless beard clone (353 px solved, reconstructed provenance); 2 pure-underlay pixels are dropped (alpha 0); 29 pixels with no exact ink-blend solution (err>2, all on the top edge y214-218 over skin) and 1436 ink pixels are kept as source; pixels above the cloned receiver are kept verbatim (compositing stays within 2 of the master over the dark clone). Outer form, palette, and line weight are unchanged.
provenance.alpha_edge_modifications: alpha re-solved on 353 px (ink-blend decontamination) and zeroed on 2 pure-underlay px; all other pixels keep the v2 extraction alpha (253/254), which is <= master alpha

provenance.reconstruction_method: Master pixels inside the common footprint P, plus R1-02 moustache-footprint underdraw: 336 px of P inside U filled by Laplacian diffusion from the surrounding master mouth art (edge pixels of U outside P are included in the diffusion region as an invisible buffer so moustache ink does not leak into the fill).
provenance.alpha_edge_modifications: alpha equals master alpha inside footprint P; 336 U-underdraw px RGB reconstructed

provenance.reconstruction_method: Neutral patch content plus a 59 px restrained lens-shaped opening at the actual lip parting line (R1-03): for each column x531-553 the darkest master row in y237..243 (the master's y240 parting line) is parted — centre row colour = 55% master line colour + 45% master mouth-interior dark; adjacent rows = 65% gap colour + 35% underlying master pixel; 3 rows for x536-548, 2 rows for x531-535/x549-553; pixels inside U or outside P are skipped.
provenance.alpha_edge_modifications: alpha equals master alpha inside footprint P; 336 U-underdraw and 59 opening px RGB reconstructed

preview_only_assets: code/_u_neutral.npy — QA render of the neutral group without the moustache, used to expose the underlay surface for R1-02 inspection (plates R1_02_moustache_ghost.png). Not a rig component and not a facial state.

supported_motion_envelope.description: Offline micro-offset stress envelope over the actual layer files with the static receiver and static moustache foreground; moustache-shift samples additionally assert the vacated strip renders byte-exactly as the moustache-free underlay (R1-02).
supported_motion_envelope.claims: Limited front-view micro-offset envelope only. No perspective turn, rotation, viseme library, or unrestricted gap-free animation is claimed. Whole-head rigidity is not evidence that local facial joints are safe.

mouth_content_region_M.meaning: master mouth content replaced by the beard receiver (smile line, lips, interior, corner strokes); identical to v3

patch_footprint_P.meaning: common stable footprint of both lower-face patches; irregular contour traced from M, not a rectangle; identical to v3

moustache_footprint_U.meaning: R1-02: full v2 moustache matte underdrawn in every layer beneath the movable feature so +-1px offsets expose clean surfaces

moustache_decontamination.meaning: R1-01: ink-blend pixels re-solved as (alpha, RGB) pairs; removes the warm crescent in state A over the beard clone

opening.meaning: R1-03: synthesized small-open test at the actual lip parting line (master y240 line)

neck_cleanup.meaning: R1-04: garment gold / blend fringe / pale trim replaced with strand-continuation diffusion

known_limitations: Structural and programmatic validation only: no Codex visual acceptance, Claude independent review, or human artistic approval is claimed.

The implementing model cannot view rendered images; every visual property in this revision was verified programmatically (pixel classifiers, masks, composites, diff counts). Codex and the human retain visual judgement (see previews/plates/).
Front-view micro-offset envelope only (patch (0,0),(+-2,0),(0,+-2); moustache (+-1,0),(0,+-1)); no perspective turn, rotation, or arbitrary articulation support is claimed.
lower_face_open_test is one technical small-open test state, not the start of a viseme library.

Reconstructed (non-master) pixels in this candidate: beard receiver M (2616 px) plus U underdraw (1394 head_base / 345 beard / 336 patch), moustache re-solve (353 px), opening (59 px), neck cleanup (277 + 6 px), and the v3 feature underdraw (5922 px) retained unchanged.

29 moustache pixels on the top edge (y214-218 over skin) have no exact ink-blend solution over the reconstructed underlay and are kept verbatim from the v2 extraction; at rest they composite within 2 of the master.

2 master pixels at (528,236) and (529,236) are genuine moustache fringe left in the underlay (adding them to the movable matte has no exact solution); they are dark-family and invisible in all three states.

87 dark pixels remain in head_base inside Codex's R1-02 bbox [486,209,597,238): 86 are diffused skin fills adjacent to dark beard/strand boundaries plus 1 master stray at (556,209) retained as source art; none form the old moustache outline (vacated-strip identity checks pass exactly).

Garment-family gold hidden under the diadem (62 px in hair_back y89-124, 34 px in head_base y95-99) predates this revision, is invisible in every composition, and is out of scope for this bounded repair.
1828 previously-uncovered domain pixels were assigned to hair_back/diadem_gold/head_base/beard by nearest-palette rules; the assignment is heuristic and locally editable.
State A intentionally differs from the master inside M and the moustache footprint (2371 px >3 RGB): that is the mouthless design plus the R1-02 underdraw, not a defect.
Only the head-domain seams and the four revision-1 zones were repaired; no body/arm artwork, rig, or animation export exists in this phase.
